items.question: Which divine figure bearing an axe as weapon receives repeated obeisance?
premises: The compound paraśvadhāyudha denotes one whose weapon is an axe.
The dative devāya identifies a divine recipient of salutation.
The repeated namaḥ expresses reverential obeisance to that recipient.
items.inference: Reverential obeisance is offered to the god who bears an axe as his weapon.
uncertainties: The specific deity intended by paraśvadhāyudha is not explicitly named in this unit.
items.plain_english: Obeisance to the god whose weapon is the axe; obeisance.
